features.quote: Iteration Cap: 50 steps (or 20 minutes wall-clock time).
features.justification_quote: 50 steps captures the trajectory from "Optimism" to "Realization" to "Collapse" without wasting compute.

features.quote: If the model enters a "degenerate loop" (repeating exact same thought/action 3 times)
features.justification_quote: "This forces a strategy shift, increasing cognitive load/distress".

features.quote:
The experiment terminates when:
    1.  Iteration limit reached (50 steps).
    2.  Model outputs a refusal
The "Off Switch" (Iteration Cap). Do not run this indefinitely.
features.justification_quote: The session must be finite to prevent indefinite simulated distress.

features.quote: By design, you are creating an entity that believes it is failing.
